decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

It is considered that extending the potential usage of the site from its existing B1 and B2 classification to also include B8 usage, will allow for the sites continued facilitation as an employment premises without compromising the functionality or balance of the Mount Road Industrial Estate.  It will not result in any adverse traffic related impacts and has due regard for the amenity of the nearby residents.  It is therefore considered to be in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) E.1.3 (Location of General Industry (B2) and Storage and Distribution (B8) Uses) E.1.5 (Development involving the Loss of or Changes in Employment Uses) E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria) T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.4.1 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - C13	The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as office space ancillary to the main use of the premises and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 4 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Change of use from B1and B2 to B1(b) (c), B2 and B8 uses.
